heading: side
name: 側欄標題組＋縮圖圖文直列（卡片區塊）
desc: 左側窄欄放標題與按鈕，右側是多列項目，每列左邊一張橫式縮圖、右邊標題與次要文字；整個區塊是左右貼齊畫面的圓角卡片。手機改為橫向滑動。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是卡片，左右兩側貼齊畫面邊緣，上下留邊、與上下區塊之間露出頁面底色；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。標題組放在左側一欄，約佔內容寬度的兩成，靠上、靠左，下方留空；標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放按鈕，上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略；標題不特別大，和項目標題大小相近。右側約八成是多個項目排成的直列，每列一筆，項目之間沒有分隔線。每個項目無外框：左側是一張橫式圖片，約佔右欄四分之一寬，圖片左上角可疊放一個小標籤，沒有時省略；圖片右側是標題（可多行），下方是一段次要文字，文字相對圖片垂直置中。所有項目的圖片同為橫式。
mobile: 改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：標題組移到項目上方，標題靠左、按鈕靠右放在同一列；項目改為橫向排列，一次露出一個項目約佔畫面寬六成，右側露出下一個項目的一部分並延伸到畫面右緣，可用手指左右滑動切換。每個項目改為橫式圖片在上（小標籤仍疊在圖片左上角），下方是標題，再下方是次要文字。區塊仍是左右貼齊畫面、四角圓角的卡片。

en.name: Side heading group + thumbnail rows list (card section)
en.desc: A narrow left column holds the title and a button; the right side is a list of rows, each with a landscape thumbnail on the left and a title with secondary text on the right. The whole section is a rounded card flush with the left and right screen edges. On mobile it becomes horizontally swipeable.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a card, flush with the left and right edges of the screen, with a margin above and below so the page background shows between it and the sections above and below; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded corners. Place the heading group in a side column on the left, taking about twenty percent of the content width, aligned to the top and left, with empty space below it. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a button below and a label above; omit them when there is no content. The title is not especially large and is close in size to the item titles. The right side, about eighty percent, is a list of rows made of multiple items, one item per row, with no dividers between items. Each item has no border: on the left is a landscape image taking about a quarter of the right column's width, optionally with a label overlaid on the image's top-left corner (omit it when there is no content); to the right of the image is a title (may wrap to multiple lines) with secondary text below it, the text vertically centered relative to the image. All item images are landscape.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The list becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: the heading group moves above the items, with the title on the left and the button on the right in the same row; the items are arranged horizontally, one item visible at a time taking about sixty percent of the screen width, with part of the next item showing on the right and extending to the right edge of the screen; items can be switched by swiping left and right. Each item becomes a landscape image on top (the label still overlaid on the image's top-left corner), with the title below and the secondary text below that. The section remains a card flush with the left and right screen edges with all four corners rounded.
